items.headline: Leads Commanders to comeback win
items.text: Daniels completed 23 of 35 passes for 289 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and added six carries for 55 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.

items.headline: Extends TD streak despite season-low yardage
items.text: McCaffrey rushed 12 times for 49 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.

items.headline: Does little with 11 touches
items.text: Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for one yard in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

items.headline: Off injury report
items.text: Diggs (personal) was removed from the Commanders' injury report Thursday.

items.headline: Five grabs in loss to Philly
items.text: Pickens caught five of nine targets for 67 yards in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.

items.headline: Paces pass catchers in loss
items.text: Kelce brought in four of seven targets for 71 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.

items.headline: Clear top back against Bears
items.text: Etienne carried the ball 14 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 21-13 loss to Chicago.

items.headline: Cleared of head injury
items.text: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that London was cleared of a concussion near the end of Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

items.headline: Only 15 total yards in Week 11
items.text: Black notched six carries for eight yards and secured his only target for seven yards during Sunday's 35-10 win versus the Vikings in Mexico City.

items.headline: Two catches in return
items.text: Kincaid brought in both targets for 13 yards in the Bills' 13-10 loss to the Chiefs on Thursday.

items.headline: Held in check by Chicago
items.text: Shough completed 25 of 42 passes for 222 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears. He added 34 rushing yards on three carries.

items.headline: Handles five touches in defeat
items.text: Rodriguez rushed four times for 28 yards in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants. He added one catch for 13 yards on one target.

items.headline: Another DNP on Thursday
items.text: Addison (thumb) was listed as a non-participant on Thursday's injury report.

items.headline: Season-best effort in win
items.text: Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.headline: Held in check by Commanders
items.text: Chase secured five of nine targets for 31 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.

items.headline: Paces pass catchers in win
items.text: Mumpfield brought in four of five targets for 69 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Another TD in Week 12 loss
items.text: Johnson rushed 17 times for 72 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 24 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.

items.headline: Struggles with accuracy in win
items.text: McCarthy completed 18 of 38 passes for 173 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.headline: Finds end zone twice against Jets
items.text: McConkey caught five of eight targets for 37 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.

items.headline: Scores TD in return from injury
items.text: Croskey-Merritt rushed 13 times for 54 yards and a touchdown and brought in two of three targets for 23 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.

items.headline: Full practice Wednesday
items.text: Darnold (quadriceps) practiced fully Wednesday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

items.headline: Strikes for three TDs in Week 11
items.text: Coleman reeled off 111 yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries and hauled in four of five targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win against the Raiders.

items.headline: Does little with 10 targets
items.text: Douglas caught two of 10 targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.

items.headline: Six receptions in return
items.text: Hockenson (wrist) caught six of seven targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.headline: Thankful for two late TDs in win
items.text: Odunze caught six of nine targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.

items.headline: Estimated as full participant Thursday
items.text: Fannin (groin) was listed as a full practice participant on Thursday's injury report, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Makes three catches Sunday
items.text: Waddle secured three of six targets for 61 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win versus the Raiders.

items.headline: Heading to D.C.
items.text: Aiyuk is slated to sign with the Commanders' practice squad, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.headline: Can't make up for dreadful defense
items.text: Prescott completed 19 of 28 passes for 291 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles. He added 19 yards and a TD on two carries.

items.headline: Big numbers in Thanksgiving win
items.text: Swift carried the ball nine times for 65 yards and a touchdown and caught seven of eight targets for 97 yards in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.

items.headline: Solid numbers in blowout loss
items.text: Robinson rushed 16 times for 71 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: Logs full practice Thursday
items.text: Flowers (ankle) was listed as a full participant in Thursday's practice.

items.headline: Seven catches in Week 11 loss
items.text: Jefferson caught seven of nine targets for 86 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.headline: Still limited by ankle injury
items.text: Meyers was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice due to an ankle injury.

items.headline: Churns out 69 rushing yards in loss
items.text: Gordon rushed 11 times for 69 yards while catching two of three targets for minus-2 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.

items.headline: Keeps piling up TDs in win
items.text: Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.headline: Tops 300 yards in Week 12 loss
items.text: Goff completed 25 of 36 passes for 313 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 10 rushing yards on three carries.

items.headline: Limited to three catches in loss
items.text: Kraft brought in three of five targets for 24 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Not on initial Week 12 practice report
items.text: Stevenson was not listed on the Patriots' practice report Wednesday.

items.headline: Has three receptions Sunday
items.text: Allen totaled three catches (on four targets) for 38 yards during Sunday's 35-10 victory against the Vikings in Mexico City.

items.headline: Without clear timeline for return
items.text: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that he has no new updates on the status of Conner (foot), who is still "working to return to perform," Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.

items.headline: Helps lead big comeback
items.text: Watson completed 25 of 40 passes for 312 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while adding eight rushes for 49 yards and a score in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with Cleveland.

items.headline: Completely overshadowed by Corum
items.text: Williams rushed 12 times for 46 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Gets into end zone in loss
items.text: Higgins brought in two of three targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.

items.headline: Gets into end zone Thursday
items.text: Collins secured three of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.headline: Seen with right arm in sling
items.text: Goedert (shoulder) had his right arm in a sling following Thursday's 39-38 victory over the Cowboys, Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.com reports.

items.headline: Leaves game with chest injury
items.text: Higbee exited Wednesday's game against the Packers with a chest injury and will not return, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

items.headline: Steps up in Week 11 loss
items.text: Hill carried the ball six times for 69 yards and a touchdown and caught four of five targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.

items.headline: Another 300-yard effort in loss
items.text: Burrow completed 28 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed twice for minus-1 yard in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.

items.headline: Thrives in workhorse role
items.text: Cook rushed 32 times for 117 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for eight yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.

items.headline: Six grabs on Thanksgiving
items.text: Williams caught six of nine targets for 68 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 12 yards on his lone carry.

items.headline: Limping after Thursday's game
items.text: Smith (back) was seen limping badly in the locker room after Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys, Martin Frank of the Delaware News Journal reports.

items.headline: Two early TDs in Week 11 win
items.text: Kittle caught all three of his targets for 34 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.

items.headline: Splits workload in Week 11 loss
items.text: Allgeier carried the ball seven times for 23 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City.

items.headline: Downplays injury after Thursday's game
items.text: Williams said after Thursday's 39-35 win in Detroit that he's "fine" and likely just has "a bruise on his abdomen," Jason Lieser of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

items.headline: Struggles against Rams in loss
items.text: Love completed 17 of 29 passes for 198 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed once for seven yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Finds end zone three times in loss
items.text: Williams carried the ball 29 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns while catching all three of his targets for 22 yards and a third TD in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.

items.headline: Inefficient night in loss
items.text: Golden secured one of five targets for 39 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Listed as limited again
items.text: Smith-Njigba (ankle) was listed as limited on Thursday's injury report, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.

items.headline: Another limited listing
items.text: Likely (groin) was listed as limited on Thursday's practice report, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

items.headline: Listed DNP on Thursday
items.text: McMillan (foot) was listed as a DNP on Thursday's practice estimate, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Listed as limited Thursday
items.text: Evans (Achilles) was listed as limited on Thursday's practice report, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

items.headline: Comes up short against Giants
items.text: Lawrence completed 25 of 47 passes for 301 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed three times for seven yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday. He also fumbled twice but recovered.

items.headline: Notches 100 total yards with TD
items.text: Hall rushed 20 times for 86 yards while catching all three of his targets for 14 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.

items.headline: Eclipses 100-yard mark vs. former squad
items.text: Pollard rushed 21 times for 110 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

items.headline: Big yardage in Thanksgiving loss

items.headline: Team-high yardage in Week 12 win
items.text: Shakir brought in three of six targets for 33 yards in the Bills' 13-10 in over the Chiefs on Thursday.

items.headline: Just three catches in Thanksgiving win
items.text: Burden caught three of seven targets for 44 yards in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.
